channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Davis Bertans | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Davis Bertans from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Davis Bertans
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on if Davis Bertans’ revised contract will affect his playing time:

“(His contract) has not had any barring of what I’ve done to this point. I know what’s best for the team regardless of anybody’s contract.”

Mark Daigneault on Davis Bertans, Dec 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Davis Bertans
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Scott Brooks on Davis Bertans in the starting lineup last night:

“It was average. It didn't pay off the way I thought it would. He did get more shots in the first half, so that's a plus... don't know what we're going to do tomorrow as of yet.”

Scott Brooks on Davis Bertans, May 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Davis Bertans
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Bertans:

“We need a good DB all-around game, and he’s very capable of it…He’s due for a good night.”

Scott Brooks on Davis Bertans, May 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Davis Bertans
item.description:
More from Brooks on Bertans:

“Having him on the court also creates driving lanes., and we’ve got some wrinkles in our offense that if they do help on certain play sets we run, it puts them in a tough position and Brad or Russell can create and make plays.”

Scott Brooks on Davis Bertans, Apr 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Deni Avdija on Davis Bertans
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Rui Hachimura with big praise for rookie Deni Avdija:

“He's a good shooter... almost like a D.B. [Davis Bertans]... he moves like a guard, he can play a lot of positions.”

Deni Avdija on Davis Bertans, Dec 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Davis Bertans
item.description:
Fred Katz:Tommy Sheppard on re-signing Davis Bertans:

“I try to be transparent in everything I do, everything I say. I know words have currency. And I said from the jump he was the priority.”

Tommy Sheppard on Davis Bertans, Nov 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Davis Bertans
item.description:
Tommy Sheppard on upcoming free agent Davis Bertans:

“He’s been a priority. I told him that. And really, nothing has changed there.”

Tommy Sheppard on Davis Bertans, Aug 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Troy Brown Jr. on Davis Bertans
item.description:
Troy Brown Jr. on Davis Bertans opting out:

“I fully support his decision. I feel like he's making the best decision for him.”

Troy Brown Jr. on Davis Bertans, Jul 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Davis Bertans
item.description:
In the case of Napier and Bertans, Washington's general manager Tommy Sheppard talked highly of both in a Q&A with Dave Johnson Thursday.

“I think with [Napier and Bertans], when we acquired them not as rentals we acquired them to stay here,”

Tommy Sheppard on Davis Bertans, Apr 10, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: John Wall on Davis Bertans
item.description:
Chase Hughes:John Wall on @NBCSWashington broadcast on Davis Bertans:

“I feel like that would be the best shooter I've ever played with...he has the ultimate greenlight.”

John Wall on Davis Bertans, Feb 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: John Wall on Davis Bertans
item.description:
Miller asked Wall who has impressed him the most this season during the time he has sat out and watched while recovering from a ruptured left Achilles.

“Bertans. I knew he could shoot the ball being with the Spurs, but I never knew he could shoot the ball that well. I think it's very amazing if I get the opportunity to have him and Brad on both ends at one time,”

John Wall on Davis Bertans, Feb 6, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Ted Leonsis, Davis Bertans
item.description:
Fred Katz:Sheppard on Bertans:

“When somebody tells me this is where they want to be, I take em at face value for that... His agent, Ted Leonsis and everyone on down, everyone in our organization has made it clear: 'Davis, this is a great place for you and you've been great for us.’”

Tommy Sheppard on Ted Leonsis, Davis Bertans, Feb 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Davis Bertans
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on how he thinks Davis Bertans would do in the 3-point contest:

“I think he wins it. … I think he’s as good of a shooter as I’ve ever been around.… And you know what? He’s probably gonna stay in the night before, as well.”

Scott Brooks on Davis Bertans, Jan 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Davis Bertans
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Scott Brooks on Davis Bertans, a career 40% three-point shooter:

“He's as good of a shooter that I've ever been aroundbut you know what? I find it intriguing... he's not a one-trick pony.”

Scott Brooks on Davis Bertans, Oct 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Michael Malone on Matt Bonner, Davis Bertans
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Nuggets' Malone on Bertans:

“You look at him and think he is Matt Bonner, but he is not Matt Bonner. They have a hell of a young player.”

Michael Malone on Matt Bonner, Davis Bertans, Feb 4, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Davis Bertans
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Gregg Popovich on Davis Bertans going 6 of 11 on 3s:

“I won't have to tell him to shoot when he is open, which is great. And he gets it off pretty quickly.”

Gregg Popovich on Davis Bertans, Oct 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
